name: orchard-door-draw-two-v1
description: ⛔ 09/09/2026: THIS OVERLAY IS NOW A NO-OP. Dean chose Draw 2 for the commons (C3), so workers.roster.draw.draw is 2/2 in the shipped data and this arm sets it to what it already is. THE ARM THAT ASKS THE QUESTION IN THE LIVE DIRECTION IS overlays/commons-draw-three.overlay.json. It is kept rather than retired because four reports name it and because the argument below is still exactly what overlays/v31-card-visit.overlay.json runs on. ⚠️ NOTE WHAT HAS CHANGED IN THE ARGUMENT: it assumes the slot's alternative is a FREE Draw 1, and the commons has no free option at all - but the commons does charge a CARD for a play, so a Draw 2 board returns 2 for 1 where every other board returns a whole action. The old prediction (Orchard traffic collapses) may come true for half of the old reason. THE PAIRED CONTROL FOR THE ONE PRINTED EXCEPTION IN THE DOOR SET (v31, 02/09/2026). v31 made all five doors PLAIN - place a card on a suit's Notice Board, take that suit's action exactly as the core action performs it - with one exception: the Orchard door is Draw 3, where plain would be Draw 2. This arm removes the exception and makes it plain. THE ARITHMETIC THE EXCEPTION IS DEFENDING. A visitor pays 1 card onto the board. The bonus slot's OTHER option is a free Draw 1 (rules.turn.bonusDraw), which costs nothing. So a Draw 2 door costs 1 and returns 2, netting +1 - exactly what the free option gives for nothing - which makes it STRICTLY WORSE than its own alternative, because the free option also leaves the card in your hand. Draw 3 nets +2, and that single card is the whole margin the Orchard board has. The prediction is therefore sharp and falsifiable: under this overlay the Orchard Notice Board should take close to ZERO visitor traffic, from rivals and from its own owner alike, while every other door is unchanged. READ IN THIS ORDER: (1) door mix by suit, where Orchard should collapse and the other four should rise slightly as the traffic redistributes; (2) the bonus mix, where the Draw-1 share should rise; (3) the Orchard seat's win rate, which is the second half of the story - the Orchard seat loses the freight its board used to collect, and freight is the only thing the owner is ever paid; (4) cards drawn per turn, which is the sanity check that the arm did what it says. IF ORCHARD'S TRAFFIC DOES NOT COLLAPSE, the self-cancellation law has stopped describing this game and the exception can be retired - which would be the more interesting result of the two, because it would mean visitors are choosing doors on something other than card arithmetic. THE DIAL IN THE OTHER DIRECTION IS rules.turn.bonusDraw, not this: raising the free draw to 2 kills the Orchard door at 3 by exactly the same argument, and kills the other four with it. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ DELIVERY MEEPLE PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the delivery meeple ON as the shipped default (rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace 1, meepleSpendTiming 'afterAction', meepleSpendPerTurn 1, meepleSpendDistinctColours false) together with two new island rules, the space choice (rules.turn.deliverySpaceChoice true: a delivery names either free space) and the closing draw (rules.turn.closingDrawPerCrate 1: filling a tile draws one card per crate). This overlay predates it, so all six leaves are pinned here BY NAME at their pre-ruling values (deliveryMeepleSpace null, meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null, meepleSpendDistinctColours false, deliverySpaceChoice false, closingDrawPerCrate 0; 'start' and null are the old inert values, not 'none' and 0) and it still replays its own game.
